query: What happens after I ring both bells of awakening?
ground_truth_answer: Kingseeker Frampt appears at Firelink Shrine; you can feed him items for souls and sell items to him.

query: How do I sell items for souls in Dark Souls 1?
ground_truth_answer: After ringing both bells, Frampt at Firelink Shrine lets you discard items for souls; Snuggly offers simple trades.
